classify.why_this_intent: The query asks for the five sectors with the highest total recorded investment, which requires aggregating and sorting the numeric 'totalInvestment' field in the SectorAllocation class.

generate.initial_sparql:
PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX kg: <https://wealth.example.org/kg/>
PREFIX wmmeta: <https://wealth.example.org/metadata/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema1: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?sectorLabel (SUM(xsd:decimal(?investment)) AS ?totalInvestment)
WHERE {
  ?alloc a wm:SectorAllocation ;
         wm:hasSector ?sector ;
         wm:totalInvestment ?investment .
  ?sector rdfs:label ?sectorLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?sectorLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?totalInvestment)
LIMIT 5
